metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the C++20 CLI in [output/CMakeLists.txt](/workspace/output/CMakeLists.txt) and [output/main.cpp](/workspace/output/main.cpp). It builds with `cmake -B build && cmake --build build`.

The fixed-format reader/writer, canonical JSON handling, `parse`, `write`, `query`, `roundtrip`, and evaluation for Lines, Circular Arcs, Copious Data, and Rational B-Spline Curves are implemented. I verified a Line file can be written, parsed, queried, evaluated, and round-tripped to byte-identical output.

**This is not a complete implementation of the requested specification.** Many of the 87 entity schemas and required curve and surface evaluators are still unsupported, so it does not yet meet the full-compatibility requirement.
